    The tautological Hom decomposition of the shift-orbit category #

    The abstract Gabriel Hom interface is indexed by a multiplicative group, whereas Mathlib's shift action is indexed by an additive group. This file reindexes the shift-orbit Hom direct sum along Multiplicative.ofAdd and packages the result as the exact FunctorOrbitHomDecomposition used by the local full-faithfulness theorems.
